positive_terms: Disclosure of  whether and how target relates to prevention and control of  substances of concern and substances of very high concern
目标与关注物质防控关系

Disclosure of  whether and how target relates to prevention and control of  substances of concern and substances of very high concern。目标与关注物质防控关系。按目标、介质、物质、场址及期间保存。企业分配的阈值与环境整体生态阈值分开；法定目标和自愿目标必须由原文支持。
